name: Samsung Galaxy S26 (Demo Unit)
shortDescription: Open-box demo (display) unit of the Samsung Galaxy S26. It has a 15.93 cm (6.3 inch) 120 Hz Dynamic AMOLED 2X display, Exynos 2600, 12 GB RAM and a 50 MP triple camera.
description:
This is a demo (display) unit of the Samsung Galaxy S26 that was used for in-store demonstration, sold open-box at a lower price. It may show light signs of handling. Please contact us before ordering if you'd like to know its exact condition, the accessories included and the remaining manufacturer warranty.

The Samsung Galaxy S26 has a 15.93 cm (6.3 inch) FHD+ Dynamic AMOLED 2X display with a refresh rate of up to 120 Hz, and runs on the Exynos 2600 processor with 12 GB RAM.

On the back are three cameras: 50 MP, 10 MP with 3x optical zoom, and 12 MP. The front camera is 12 MP, and the phone records video in up to 8K at 30 fps.

It has an Armor Aluminum frame with Corning Gorilla Glass Victus 2 on the front and back, an IP68 rating, a 4,300 mAh battery (typical), Wi-Fi 7, NFC and eSIM support. Samsung lists security updates until 28 February 2033. A charger (travel adapter) is not included in the box.
